subject: c-fo-act
title: C.FO.ACT.------T.C.IMP.
description: Diagram in MID-W-12, on the page where Braxton begins describing the AACM's free music school program — 'in 1967, the Association for the Advancement of Creative Musicians addressed itself to one of the most important problems facing the black community' — and the structural commitment to community engagement. C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) is crossed with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). RT-ALGN (reality alignment) branches from the main line. CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) branches from the main line and opens into MT-INFO (multi-information); MT-INFO opens into EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) and POL-DYM (political dynamics) → C-CONT (composite continuance). A dotted line runs from the main line to INFO-INTR (information interpretation), which opens into DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular).
